summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature in the MONAI repo; nothing was run and nothing was committed. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs with coords computed from the padding offset; set_rnd skips "__"-prefixed attributes; docstring updated), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter wrapping iter_patch with copy-back disabled; GridPatchDataset rewritten to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates and to raise NotImplementedError("image dataset must implement `len()`.") when len fails; math replaced by numpy ceil; PatchDataset docstring np.float fixed to float; PatchIter added to __all__), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset), and tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array). Judgment calls: test images are np.arange(16) (inferred so the pinned values match); the two-worker block re-calls set_determinism before its loader; the docstring example output is reasoned, not run. The pinned two-worker values are unverified. Three pre-existing over-120-character lines in get_valid_patch_size's docstring were left unchanged.
